art_direction: 裂纹白瓷风筝悬空，尾绳串着几片真实小云，桃色背景上呈现轻盈材质反差。
composition: one original focal subject, centered and readable within a circular avatar crop
creative_direction: Suspend a diamond-shaped kite made from thin white crackle-glazed porcelain at the center of a muted peach square. Its slender frame is visible through a few translucent glaze areas, and its tail is a dark thread carrying three small soft clouds instead of ribbon bows. Tilt the kite in a light diagonal, with one corner catching a cool reflection. Render the ceramic crazing delicately and keep the cloud edges airy but compact. The thread should connect every element clearly and remain within a safe avatar crop. No sky panorama, figures, or text. The contrast between a fragile heavy material and an object meant to fly should drive the original surreal composition.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
visual_review: passed: compressed preview inspected for clear original focal composition, requested medium and detail level, circular-crop readability, no unintended anatomy or rendering defects, no text or watermark
